title: Bronze by gold, Miss Kennedy’s head by Miss Douce’s head, appeared above the crossblind of the Ormond hotel.
html_source: “Bronze by gold” & “gold by bronze” referring to the hair colours of the two Ormond Hotel barmaids are from now on recurring motifs.
